title: Extract text from file (OCR)
description: Reads text and tables from an uploaded file or a file URL. Configure either artifactId or fileUrl, not both.

artifactId.title: Uploaded file
artifactId.description: Identifier of an uploaded file. Use this or File URL, not both.

fileUrl.title: File URL
fileUrl.description: Address of a file to read. Use this or Uploaded file, not both.

detectTables.title: Detect tables
detectTables.description: Also detect tables in the document.
